svg.title: Azure Local deployment models
svg.desc: Two conceptual storage arrangements. Hyperconverged workloads use compute nodes with local disks contributing to a Storage Spaces Direct pool. Disaggregated workloads access qualified external block storage through a redundant storage fabric. Both designs require storage repair capacity plus compute failure reserve. Arrows represent data paths, not physical cabling.

svg.text: Conceptual data paths only; not physical cabling. Read each column top to bottom.
Local disks share the compute nodes.
Keep separate reserves for storage repair, compute failover.
Storage-array resiliency does not replace compute reserve.
